newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Kuehbacher says Buba satisfied with dollar.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Kuehbacher says Buba satisfied with dollar.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Klaus-Dieter Kuehbacher said on Friday that Germany's central bank was satisfied with current dollar levels.
"We are satisfied with the dollar," Kuehbacher told reporters at a banking congress here.
Kuehbacher, who is also president of the state central bank in Berlin and Brandenburg, added that the dollar's current rates against the mark showed a normalisation.
The dollar was trading at 1.6616 marks this morning.
"Many U.S. economic data argued in favour of a stronger dollar and that is what we have now," Kuehbacher said.
